ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; predominantly high-intensity white pixels (>85%) across the central fluke surface with a sharp transition to low-intensity black pixels at the perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions across both fluke lobes. Solid black contiguous banding along the trailing edges and tips. A localized cluster of dark pixels is mapped at the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated acute angle and significant bounding-box depth extending approximately 20% into the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, non-uniform serrations along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge, with a distinct irregular protrusion on the terminal end of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory along the trailing edge; left lobe terminates in a sharper acuminate point whereas the right lobe exhibits a more rounded/blunted terminal geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of high-contrast, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the dark dorsal surface in the foreground.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across the dorsal back surface; minor irregular morphology/notching on the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry between the sharp left fluke tip and the blunted/rounded right fluke tip.
